Finalize a Window Frame

Source: R/define_window.R
finalize_windows.Rd

Restores the pre-cross-join row order, marks which rows ended up with a usable window, and assigns a stable per-row id for the downstream SQL layer.

Usage

finalize_windows(window_dt)

Arguments

window_dt

A data.table with .window_row_id, window_start, and window_end already populated.

Value

window_dt, reordered, with .window_row_id removed and window_valid / anchor_row_id columns added.
